# Post-Failure Circuit Breaker & Court-Martial Docket

Post-failure interceptor: counts consecutive quality gate failures on a module; at attempt 3, trips circuit breaker and emits Court-Martial docket.

## Invariants
- TRIP_TO_TRIPPED_ABORT_ON_ATTEMPT_3
- EMIT_STRUCTURED_COURT_MARTIAL_DOCKET
- FREEZE_AUTOMATED_RETRY_LOOPS
